title: Orbita — dark cinematic space landing page
license: original work (agent-generated; added at explicit user request 2026-10-25)
source: agent-built single-page site, restructured to template layout (HTML/CSS/JS split, CDN fonts removed per no-external-requests rule)
use_when: single-product marketing/launch pages wanting a dark space aesthetic: animated starfield hero with orbiting planet, bento feature grid, itinerary timeline, pricing tiers, FAQ, gradient CTA; responsive with no-JS content failsafe and prefers-reduced-motion support

layout.structure: fixed glass nav; 100svh hero (copy left, CSS planet right); marquee ribbon; 6 content sections (bento experience, timeline journey, testimonials, pricing, FAQ accordion, gradient CTA panel); footer

components.nav: fixed top bar, 72px (var(--nav-h)), glass blur on scroll, logo + 5 anchor links + CTA button; burger below 860px
components.hero: 100svh grid: eyebrow badge, h1 clamp(44px-88px) with gradient span, stats row (3 count-up numbers), two CTAs; right: pure-CSS planet with ring, glow, orbiting moon; canvas starfield behind (#stars)
components.marquee: infinite CSS scroll ribbon of mono uppercase phrases
components.bento: CSS grid of glass cards (var(--panel), radius var(--radius)), cursor-follow radial highlight, one card renders a CSS cupola window with Earth horizon
components.timeline: vertical journey with dots + glass cards, alternating alignment on desktop
components.pricing: 3 tier cards, featured tier with gradient border and 'Popular' tag
components.faq: details-free JS accordion, aria-expanded toggles, plus/minus indicator
components.cta-panel: gradient-border panel with headline + primary button
components.reveal: IntersectionObserver scroll reveals, gated behind html.js class (no-JS failsafe)

usability_rules: no external network requests (system font stacks only)
content visible with JavaScript disabled (reveal styles gated behind html.js)
prefers-reduced-motion disables starfield drift, marquee, and reveals
focus-visible outlines on interactive elements; aria-expanded on FAQ and burger
